title: Meith marketplace listing
description: One entry in marketplace/listings/*.json. Exactly these fields — extend only with maintainer sign-off, never on your own. scripts/marketplace-gen.mjs enforces this shape and a few rules a JSON Schema cannot express (the plugin key pattern, that the version fields parse, that every screenshot file exists); marketplace-gen.test.ts checks the two do not drift apart.

key.description: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens. Mirrors the plugin key rule in packages/plugin-kit/src/plugin.ts.

package.description: The npm package name a board runs `pnpm add` against.

name.description: The display name shown in a catalogue UI.

description.description: One sentence. What it is, not how to configure it.

screenshots.description: Filenames only, resolved against marketplace/screenshots/. Never a third-party URL — the generator copies the files into the site's own public assets.

version.description: The *listed package's* own version — not the repository's release version. This is the one place lockstep does not apply; see docs/marketplace.md.

apiVersion.description: The plugin-kit or theme-kit major version this listing was built against.

meith.description: A version range this listing has been checked against, e.g. ">=0.16 <1". Comparators are `>=`, `<=`, `>`, `<` or `=` against a major, major.minor, or major.minor.patch number, space-separated to mean AND.

licence.description: The listed package's licence. Checked during review for being open and truthfully named, not by the generator — see docs/marketplace.md.
